O.outcome_detail: support for reciprocal effects between reading self-concept and achievement

cells.quote: For reading constructs, Ehm et al. (2019) found support for REM with CLPMs but not RI-CLPMs. Indeed, their RI-CLPMs provided no support for either skill development or self-enhancement perspectives; there were no statistically significant cross-paths from prior ASC to subsequent achievement or from prior achievement to subsequent ASC.
cells.note: The study text reports a methodological-model contrast, not an instructional treatment.

O.outcome_detail: support for reciprocal effects between math self-concept and achievement

cells.quote: For math outcomes (Ehm et al., 2021), the CLPM and RI-CLPM results were similar and provided partial support for the REM. For both models, the cross-lagged effects were non-significant from Year 1 to Year 2, but there were reciprocal effects for Year 2 to Year 3.
cells.note: The study text reports similar, partial support across models, with effects varying by wave.

D.treatment: eHistoLab virtual microscopy plus recorded lectures

cells.quote: However, post-test scores in the eHistoLab web application group were significantly higher than those in the e-Lecturing group (P < 0.001). The effect size for the between-group post-test comparison was large (Cohen’s d = 1.31).
cells.note: Students were randomly assigned by a lottery method; the post-test followed completion of the course.

D.comparison: no institutional access to EP simulators

cells.quote: The 2024 EHRA survey on simulation training revealed that only 18% of respondents reported institutional access to EP simulators and only 20% reported formal inclusion within cardiology curricula, yet >80% of respondents rated simulation as useful or very useful for training.
cells.note: Descriptive survey finding; the study text does not report an inferential comparison between access and no access.

cells.quote: Meta-analysis of 12 medical simulation studies shows PBP training reduces procedural errors by 60%, procedure time by 15%, and increases correctly executed steps by 47% compared to conventional simulation.

O.outcome_detail: eHL subscale 1: using technology to process health information

cells.quote: Participants demonstrated enhanced overall eHL and significant progress in all 7 subscales. Specifically, notable improvements were observed in subscale 1 (using technology to process health information) and subscale 2 (understanding health concepts and language).
